killed by signal).\n    pub exit_code: Option<i32>,\n    /// Duration of the test run in milliseconds.\n    pub duration_ms: u64,\n    /// Whether the test timed out.\n    pub timed_out: bool,\n    /// Length of captured stdout in bytes.\n    pub stdout_len: usize,\n    /// Length of captured stderr in bytes.\n    pub stderr_len: usize,\n    /// When the test completed.\n    pub timestamp: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,\n}\n\nimpl TestMetrics {\n    /// Returns true if the test succeeded (exit code 0 and no timeout).\n    pub fn success(&self) -> bool {\n        self.exit_code == Some(0) && !self.timed_out\n    }\n\n    /// Get the duration as a Duration.\n    pub fn duration(&self) -> Duration {\n        Duration::from_millis(self.duration_ms)\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Cargo Test Runner\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Runner for cargo test commands.\n///\n/// ## Example\n///\n/// ```no_run\n/// use needle::cargo_test::{CargoTest, TestArgs};\n/// use std::path::Path;\n///\n/// let args = TestArgs::new()\n///     .with_target(\"--lib\")\n///     .with_filter(\"integration\");\n///\n/// let runner = CargoTest::with_args(Path::new(\"/workspace\"), args);\n/// let outcome = runner.run().unwrap();\n/// ```\npub struct CargoTest {\n    /// Workspace directory where cargo will run.\n    workspace: PathBuf,\n    /// Test arguments.\n    args: TestArgs,\n    /// Timeout in seconds.\n    timeout_secs: u64,\n}\n\nimpl CargoTest {\n    /// Create a new cargo test runner with default arguments.\n    pub fn new(workspace: &Path) -> Self {\n        CargoTest {\n            workspace: workspace.to_path_buf(),\n            args: TestArgs::default(),\n            timeout_secs: DEFAULT_TEST_TIMEOUT_SECS,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Create a new cargo test runner with custom arguments.\n    pub fn with_args(workspace: &Path, args: TestArgs) -> Self {\n        CargoTest {\n            workspace: workspace.to_path_buf(),\n            args,\n            timeout_secs: DEFAULT_TEST_TIMEOUT_SECS,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Set a custom timeout (default is 600 seconds).\n    pub fn with_timeout(mut self, timeout_secs: u64) -> Self {\n        self.timeout_secs = timeout_secs;\n        self\n    }\n\n    /// Run cargo test with the configured arguments.\n    ///\n    /// ## Errors\n    ///\n    /// Returns an error if:\n    /// - The cargo binary cannot be found\n    /// - The workspace directory is invalid\n    /// - The process cannot be spawned\n    pub fn run(&self) -> Result<TestOutcome> {\n        let start = Instant::now();\n        let args = self.args.build_args();\n\n        tracing::info!(\n            workspace = %self.workspace.display(),\n            args = ?args,\n            \"running cargo test\"\n        );\n\n        // Build the cargo command\n        let mut cmd = Command::new(\"cargo\");\n        cmd.args(&args);\n        cmd.current_dir(&self.workspace);\n        cmd.stdout(Stdio::piped());\n        cmd.stderr(Stdio::piped());\n\n        // Spawn the process\n        let mut child = cmd.spawn().context(\"failed to spawn cargo test\")?;\n\n        // Wait for completion with timeout\n        let timeout = Duration::from_secs(self.timeout_secs);\n        let _exit_status = loop {\n            match child.try_wait() {\n                Ok(Some(status)) => break status,\n                Ok(None) => {\n                    if start.elapsed() >= timeout {\n                        child\n                            .kill()\n                            .context(\"failed to kill cargo test after timeout\")?;\n                        return Ok(TestOutcome {\n                            exit_code: None,\n                            stdout: String::new(),\n                            stderr: String::from(\"command timed out\"),\n                            duration: start.elapsed(),\n                            timed_out: true,\n                        });\n                    }\n                    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));\n                }\n                Err(e) => {\n                    return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\"failed to wait for cargo test: {}\", e));\n                }\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Capture output\n        let output = child\n            .wait_with_output()\n            .context(\"failed to capture cargo test output\")?;\n\n        let stdout = truncate_output(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout));\n        let stderr = truncate_output(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr));\n\n        tracing::info!(\n            exit_code = ?output.status.code(),\n            duration_secs = start.elapsed().as_secs(),\n            success = output.status.success(),\n            \"cargo test completed\"\n        );\n\n        Ok(TestOutcome {\n            exit_code: output.status.code(),\n            stdout,\n            stderr,\n            duration: start.elapsed(),\n            timed_out: false,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Get the workspace directory.\n    pub fn workspace(&self) -> &Path {\n        &self.workspace\n    }\n\n    /// Get the test arguments.\n    pub fn args(&self) -> &TestArgs {\n        &self.args\n    }\n\n    /// Get the timeout in seconds.\n    pub fn timeout_secs(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.timeout_secs\n    }\n\n    /// Run cargo test and write output to files.\n    ///\n    /// This method runs `cargo test` and writes the captured stdout, stderr,\n    /// and combined output to separate files in the `.test_outputs/<test_name>/` directory.\n    ///\n    /// ## Arguments\n    ///\n    /// * `test_name` - A unique identifier for the test (e.g., \"integration_test_1\")\n    ///\n    /// ## Errors\n    ///\n    /// Returns an error if:\n    /// - The test run fails\n    /// - Output directory creation fails\n    /// - File writing fails\n    ///\n    /// ## Example\n    ///\n    /// ```no_run\n    /// use needle::cargo_test::CargoTest;\n    /// use std::path::Path;\n    ///\n    /// let runner = CargoTest::new(Path::new(\"/workspace\"));\n    /// let outcome = runner.run_with_output_files(\"my_test\").unwrap();\n    /// ```\n    pub fn run_with_output_files(&self, test_name: &str) -> Result<TestOutcome> {\n        // First run the test to get the outcome\n        let outcome = self.run()?;\n\n        // Create test output directory and write outputs\n        if let Some(output) = TestOutput::new(test_name, &self.workspace) {\n            // Write stdout\n            if let Err(e) = output.write_stdout(&outcome.stdout) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    test_name = %test_name,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to write stdout to file\"\n                );\n            }\n\n            // Write stderr\n            if let Err(e) = output.write_stderr(&outcome.stderr) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    test_name = %test_name,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to write stderr to file\"\n                );\n            }\n\n            // Write combined output\n            let combined = create_combined_output(&outcome.stdout, &outcome.stderr);\n            if let Err(e) = output.write_combined(&combined) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    test_name = %test_name,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to write combined output to file\"\n                );\n            }\n\n            tracing::info!(\n                test_name = %test_name,\n                stdout_path = %output.stdout_path().display(),\n                stderr_path = %output.stderr_path().display(),\n                combined_path = %output.combined_path().display(),\n                \"test output written to files\"\n            );\n        } else {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                test_name = %test_name,\n                \"failed to create test output directory, output files not written\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        Ok(outcome)\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Utility Functions\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Truncate output to at most MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES.\nfn truncate_output(s: &str) -> String {\n    if s.len() <= MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES {\n        s.to_string()\n    } else {\n        let truncated = &s[..MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES];\n        format!(\"{}... [truncated]\", truncated)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Create combined output from stdout and stderr.\n///\n/// This function combines stdout and stderr into a single string with section headers.\n///\n/// ## Example\n///\n/// ```\n/// use needle::cargo_test::create_combined_output;\n///\n/// let stdout = \"Test output line 1\\nTest output line 2\";\n/// let stderr = \"Error message\";\n/// let combined = create_combined_output(stdout, stderr);\n/// ```\npub fn create_combined_output(stdout: &str, stderr: &str) -> String {\n    let mut combined = String::new();\n\n    if !stdout.is_empty() {\n        combined.push_str(\"=== STDOUT ===\\n\");\n        combined.push_str(stdout);\n        if !stdout.ends_with('\\n') {\n            combined.push('\\n');\n        }\n    }\n\n    if !stderr.is_empty() {\n        if !combined.is_empty() {\n            combined.push('\\n');\n        }\n        combined.push_str(\"=== STDERR ===\\n\");\n        combined.push_str(stderr);\n        if !stderr.ends_with('\\n') {\n            combined.push('\\n');\n        }\n    }\n\n    combined\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Tests\n// JSON value.\n    pub fn to_data(&self) -> serde_json::Value {\n        match self {\n            EventKind::WorkerBooting {\n                worker_name,\n                version,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"worker_name\": worker_name, \"version\": version })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerStarted {\n                worker_name,\n                version,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"worker_name\": worker_name, \"version\": version })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerStopped {\n                reason,\n                beads_processed,\n                uptime_secs,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"reason\": reason,\n                    \"beads_processed\": beads_processed,\n                    \"uptime_secs\": uptime_secs,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerErrored {\n                error_type,\n                error_message,\n                beads_processed,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"error_type\": error_type,\n                    \"error_message\": error_message,\n                    \"beads_processed\": beads_processed,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerExhausted {\n                cycle_count,\n                last_strand,\n                waterfall_restarts,\n                restart_triggers,\n                strand_evaluations,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"cycle_count\": cycle_count,\n                    \"last_strand_evaluated\": last_strand,\n                    \"waterfall_restarts\": waterfall_restarts,\n                    \"restart_triggers\": restart_triggers,\n                    \"strand_evaluations\": strand_evaluations,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerIdle { backoff_seconds } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"backoff_seconds\": backoff_seconds })\n            }\n            EventKind::StateTransition { from, to } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"from\": format!(\"{from}\"), \"to\": format!(\"{to}\") })\n            }\n            EventKind::InitStepStarted { step } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"step\": step })\n            }\n            EventKind::InitStepCompleted { step, duration_ms } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"step\": step, \"duration_ms\": duration_ms })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerBootTimeout { elapsed_ms } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"elapsed_ms\": elapsed_ms })\n            }\n            EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                strand_name,\n                result,\n                duration_ms,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"strand_name\": strand_name,\n                    \"result\": result,\n                    \"duration_ms\": duration_ms,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::StrandSkipped {\n                strand_name,\n                reason,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"strand_name\": strand_name, \"reason\": reason })\n            }\n            EventKind::QueueEmpty => serde_json::json!({}),\n            EventKind::PluckStarvationDetected {\n                workspace,\n                open_count,\n                excluded_count,\n                candidate_exclusion_reasons,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"workspace\": workspace,\n                    \"open_count\": open_count,\n                    \"excluded_count\": excluded_count,\n                    \"candidate_exclusion_reasons\": candidate_exclusion_reasons,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::ClaimAttempt { bead_id, attempt } => {\n EventKind::ClaimRaceLostSkipped {\n                consecutive_losses,\n                threshold,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"consecutive_losses\": \"reason\": reason })\n            }\n            EventKind::BeadReleaseFailed { bead_id, reason } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(), \"reason\": reason })\n            }\n            EventKind::BeadCompleted {\n                bead_id,\n                duration_ms,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(), EventKind::DispatchStarted {\n                bead_id,\n                agent,\n                prompt_len,\n                template_name,\n                template_version,\n                prompt_hash,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"agent\": agent,\n                    \"prompt_len\": prompt_len,\n                    \"template_name\": template_name,\n                    \"template_version\": template_version,\n                    \"prompt_hash\": exit_code,\n                    \"duration_ms\": duration_ms,\n                    \"agent\": agent,\n                    \"model\": model,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::RoutingDecision {\n                bead_id,\n                model,\n                matched_rule,\n                chosen_adapter,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"model\": model,\n                    \"matched_rule\": matched_rule,\n                    \"chosen_adapter\": chosen_adapter,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::RoutingFailed {\n                bead_id,\n                model,\n                rules_tried,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"model\": model,\n                    \"rules_tried\": rules_tried,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::BuildTimeout {\n                bead_id,\n                timeout_secs,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n   elapsed_ms,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"elapsed_ms\": elapsed_ms,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::OutcomeClassified {\n                bead_id,\n                outcome,\n                exit_code,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n EventKind::OutcomeHandled {\n                bead_id,\n                outcome,\n                action,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": EventKind::MendDbRebuilt => serde_json::json!({}),\n            EventKind::MendCycleSummary {\n                beads_released,\n                locks_removed,\n                deps_cleaned,\n output backend for telemetry events.\n///\n/// Implement this trait to add a new sink — register an instance in the\n/// `TelemetryBus` and events fan out automatically, with no special-casing.\npub trait Sink: Send + Sync {\n    /// Accept a single event. Must not block indefinitely.\n    fn accept(&self, event: &TelemetryEvent) -> Result<()>;\n\n    /// Flush any buffered state before shutdown.\n    ///\n    /// Implementations should respect `deadline`: if flushing cannot complete\n    /// within the duration, return an error rather than blocking indefinitely.\n    fn flush(&self, deadline: std::time::Duration) -> Result<()>;\n}\n\n/// Blanket impl for Arc-wrapped sinks.\n/// This enables Arc<Sink> to be used wherever Sink is required.\nimpl<T: Sink + ?Sized> Sink for Arc<T> {\n    fn accept(&self, event: &TelemetryEvent) -> Result<()> {\n        self.as_ref().accept(event)\n    }\n\n    fn flush(&self, deadline: std::time::Duration) -> Result<()> {\n        self.as_ref().flush(deadline)\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── FileSink ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Writes JSONL telemetry to `<log_dir>/<worker>-<session>.jsonl`.\n///\n/// Append-only, one line per event. The log directory is created if it\n/// does not exist.\npub struct FileSink {\n    path: PathBuf,\n    writer: std::sync::Mutex<std::io::BufWriter<std::fs::File>>,\n}\n\nimpl FileSink {\n    /// Construct a sink using the default log directory (`~/.needle/logs/`).\n    pub fn new(worker_id: &str, session_id: &str) -> Result<Self> {\n        let home = std::env::var(\"HOME\").unwrap_or_else(|_| \".\".to_string());\n        let log_dir = PathBuf::from(&home).join(\".needle\").join(\"logs\");\n        Self::with_dir(&log_dir, worker_id, session_id)\n    }\n\n    /// Construct a sink writing to a specific directory.\n    ///\n    /// Creates the directory (and parents) if it does not exist.\n    pub fn with_dir(log_dir: &Path, worker_id: &str, session_id: &str) -> Result<Self> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(log_dir)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to create log directory: {}\", log_dir.display()))?;\n        let filename = format!(\"{worker_id}-{session_id}.jsonl\");\n        let path = log_dir.join(filename);\n        let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .create(true)\n            .append(true)\n            .open(&path)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to open log file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        Ok(FileSink {\n            path,\n            writer: std::sync::Mutex::new(std::io::BufWriter::new(file)),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Return the path to the log file.\n    pub fn path(&self) -> &Path {\n        &self.path\n    }\n\n    /// Write a boot event directly to the file, bypassing the normal channel.\n    ///\n    /// This is called immediately after FileSink creation to ensure that even if\n    /// the writer thread fails to start, we have a trace in the JSONL file.\n    /// The event is written synchronously and flushed to disk.\n    fn write_boot_event_direct(\n        &self,\n        worker_id: &str,\n        session_id: &str,\n        version: &str,\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        Self::write_boot_event_direct_impl(\n            &self.writer,\n            &self.path,\n            worker_id,\n            session_id,\n            version,\n            std::time::Duration::from_secs(5), // 5 second timeout\n        )\n    }\n\n    /// Write a boot event directly to the file with a timeout.\n    ///\n    /// This is a timeout-aware variant that prevents indefinite blocking on hung\n    /// filesystems (e.g., network filesystem issues, stale NFS mounts). If the\n    /// write takes longer than the timeout, it returns an error and the caller\n    /// can decide whether to continue or fail.\n    ///\n    /// The timeout is implemented by spawning a thread to do the blocking I/O\n    /// and joining with a timeout. If the timeout expires, the thread is detached\n    /// and will continue running (and eventually complete or be killed by the OS).\n    fn write_boot_event_direct_impl(\n        _writer: &std::sync::Mutex<std::io::BufWriter<std::fs::File>>,\n        path: &Path,\n        worker_id: &str,\n        session_id: &str,\n        version: &str,\n        timeout: std::time::Duration,\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        use std::io::Write;\n        use std::sync::mpsc;\n        use std::thread;\n\n        let event = TelemetryEvent {\n            timestamp: Utc::now(),\n            event_type: \"worker.booting\".to_string(),\n            worker_id: worker_id.to_string(),\n            session_id: session_id.to_string(),\n            sequence: 0,\n            bead_id: None,\n            workspace: None,\n            duration_ms: None,\n            data: serde_json::json!({ \"worker_name\": worker_id, \"version\": version }),\n            trace_id: None,\n            span_id: None,\n        };\n        let line = serde_json::to_string(&event)?;\n        let path_for_error = path.display().to_string();\n        let path_clone = path.to_path_buf();\n\n        // JoinHandle::join() has no timeout in Rust's std — use a channel with recv_timeout.\n        let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel::<Result<(), String>>();\n\n        // The JoinHandle is intentionally dropped on timeout: dropping detaches the thread,\n        // which continues running until it completes or the process exits.\n        let _handle = thread::spawn(move || {\n            let result: Result<(), String> = (|| {\n                let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n                    .create(true)\n                    .append(true)\n                    .open(&path_clone)\n                    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n                let mut writer = std::io::BufWriter::new(file);\n                writeln!(writer, \"{line}\").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n                writer.flush().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n                writer.get_ref().sync_all().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n                Ok(())\n            })();\n            // Ignore send error:
